title: Worker dies from suffocation, two others saved in Tuguegarao

blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY, CAGAYAN, Philippines — A worker died of suffocation while two others were rescued after they were trapped in a deep well they were digging on Monday (Sept. 28) at Barangay Balzain in Tuguegarao City. The men were pulled out of the deep well they were contracted to undertake by residents and by responders
